nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How did the MHW metrics differ between the East and West Coasts of the U.S.?
nodes.answer: MHW metrics exhibited significant differences between the East and West Coasts, with the East Coast generally showing higher mean intensity, cumulative intensity, and yearly cumulative intensity at the 95% confidence level.
